messages.author: 6a1d61cf15ac5c37
messages.subject: Enter negative values in matrixInput
parts:
Dear all,

I am using the matrixInput function from the Shiny-incubator package and all of a sudden I realized that you cannot enter negative values in the matrix. Is there a workaround for this?

Thank you in advance,
Robbie
